batch: TA-B2b (2026-11-07): batch 2 hypotheses composed on top of the current keeper variant
evidence: B1: sharpening the BM4D target hurt (TA01 alpha 1.25: M3(42) -0.1447 vs -0.1272). diag_kspace: on the 17 transverse lesion planes MC-GS beats ZS-SSDU below |f| 0.15 and loses everything at |f| >= 0.2 cycles/px, mostly at unsampled (ky,kz); Gaussians have sigma ~0.7-1 voxel, so that band reaches the densities attenuated ~10-25x. Control TA00 vs FV06: run-to-run noise ~2.3e-4 in M3 -> keep margin 5e-4.

items.hypothesis: plug-and-play style: re-denoising every 125 steps with sigma x0.6 per refresh lets block matching propagate data-consistent high frequency, unlike the constant-sigma refreshes FV16/FV17 that over-smoothed
denser BM4D block grid (step 3 -> 2) gives a better denoised target at the same sigma (less blocking, more detail kept)
stronger version of TB01 (sigma x0.7, densities x2.92)
